status: Proposed production flow — commercial thresholds remain configurable pending CloudSwift sales validation
principles: Discover the prospect's requirement before qualification.
Ask only questions that change routing, sales context, or personalisation.
Separate fit, intent, and urgency rather than using company size as a hard HOT override.
Allow a prospect to request a human at any point without treating that action alone as proof of commercial qualification.
Reuse known data and never ask for the same contact information twice.

journey.name: Entry / Welcome
journey.trigger: First inbound message or menu restart
journey.action: Send welcome message and open Service / Need Picker (file 02).
journey.message: Hi 👋 Welcome to CloudSwift. Tell us what you're looking to solve and we'll point you to the right cloud specialist.

journey.name: Requirement selected
journey.action: Store selected requirement and acknowledge it.
journey.message_template: {{requirement_label}} — understood. I need a few quick details to route this correctly.

journey.name: Requested human
journey.meaning: Strong human-intent signal, not an automatic proof of commercial qualification.
journey.action: Capture minimum contact details if unknown, create sales-review alert, pause automation when a human accepts the conversation.

journey.name: Core qualification
questions: Q3 role in evaluation or decision
Q4 contextual question based on selected requirement

journey.name: Qualification engine

dimensions.fit: How closely the account/environment matches CloudSwift's commercial and technical scope.
dimensions.intent: Evidence of an active project, problem, requirement, dissatisfaction, or initiative.
dimensions.urgency: How soon the prospect expects action or a decision.

journey.note: No arbitrary numerical weights are locked in V2. Thresholds must remain configurable until CloudSwift sales data/service priorities validate them.

HIGH_PRIORITY.criteria: Strong commercial fit plus meaningful intent and/or urgency, or manual sales-review promotion.
sequence: Offer Book a call / Request callback / Chat now.

NURTURE_REVIEW.criteria: Relevant account but timing, intent, or commercial context does not justify immediate sales escalation.
sequence: If permission granted, run Day 3 / Day 7 / Day 21 nurture.
Escalate when a meaningful buying-intent signal appears.

LOW_INTENT_SELF_SERVE.criteria: No current opportunity detected or insufficient intent for sales action.
sequence: Allow the contact to return at any time.

safetyNets.invalid_input: Re-prompt with Try again / Talk to specialist / Main menu.
safetyNets.free_text: Store the message; classify where possible; otherwise flag for human review.
safetyNets.drop_off: Resume from the last incomplete step rather than restarting.
safetyNets.opt_out: stop / unsubscribe / cancel disables automated nurture.
safetyNets.human_takeover: Admin can pause automation at any point.
safetyNets.returning_contact: Reuse stored information and do not request known contact fields again.
